name: scheduler
description: THE ONLY WAY to schedule anything for later. Call this tool DIRECTLY with action=create the moment the user asks for a scheduled / recurring / delayed / reminder task (examples: daily backup, hourly report, remind me in 2 hours, check a website every morning, do X tomorrow). Do NOT perform the task yourself now, do NOT browse, do NOT write files, do NOT break the request into manual steps — put the whole job in ONE call: action=create, task=<the full job in the user's own words>, start_at=<when: now | in 10m | in 2h | ISO time>, repeat=<only if they asked to repeat: every 30m | daily at 09:00>. Use action=list to show jobs, pause/resume/update/delete with job_id to manage them.

job_id.description: Scheduled task ID; required for update, delete, pause, and resume.

task.description: Task to execute; required when creating.

start_at.description: First execution time, such as now, in 2h, or an ISO 8601 date/time. Default now.

repeat.description: Recurrence pattern, such as every 30m, daily at 09:00, or monthly.

repeat_count.description: Total number of executions. Omit for unlimited repetition.

timezone.description: Timezone for scheduled times. Default user/system timezone.

rules: When the user asks to schedule anything: call action=create IMMEDIATELY with the full task text — never execute the task yourself first, never browse/open/write anything for it now. Omit repeat for one-time tasks. start_at=now with repeat runs immediately, then repeats. repeat_count limits total executions.
